title: Multi-Level-Set-Based Physics-Driven Neural Network to Solve 3-D Inverse Scattering Problems
abstract: arXiv:2609.08594v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper proposes a level-set-based physics-driven neural network solver (LSPDNN) for 3-D electromagnetic inverse scattering. To mitigate boundary blurring and reconstruction artifacts in voxel-wise contrast reconstruction, the proposed solver exploits the piecewise homogeneity of practical scatterers by representing unknown targets with multiple coordinate-dependent neural level-set components. Specifically, a soft-union multi-material model is proposed to separately describe the object support and material distribution. The global support is formed by the union of multiple level-set components, while the local contrast is determined by normalized component weights and learnable complex permittivity candidates. translated_title: 基于多水平集的物理驱动神经网络求解三维逆散射问题
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种基于水平集的物理驱动神经网络求解器（LSPDNN），用于求解三维电磁逆散射问题。为了缓解逐体素对比度重建中的边界模糊和重建伪影问题，所提出的求解器利用实际散射体的分段均匀性，采用多个坐标相关的神经水平集分量来表示未知目标。具体而言，提出了一种软并集多材料模型，分别描述目标支撑域和材料分布：全局支撑域由多个水平集分量的并集形成，而局部对比度则由归一化的分量权重和可学习的复介电常数候选值共同确定。此外，在材料区域指示器上施加模型一致的总变分（TV）正则化，而非直接作用于重建的对比度上，从而在抑制碎片化材料分配的同时避免过度……
tldr: 本文提出基于多水平集的物理驱动神经网络（LSPDNN），利用软并集多材料模型将目标支撑域与材料分布分离描述，并结合作用于材料区域指示器的模型一致TV正则化，有效缓解了三维电磁逆散射重建中的边界模糊与伪影问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-level-set-based physics-driven neural network (LSPDNN) that separately describes object support and material distribution via a soft-union multi-material model, combined with model-consistent TV regularization on material-region indicators, effectively mitigating boundary blurring and reconstruction artifacts in 3-D electromagnetic inverse scattering.
